relations.notes: Soft order for the Meet-a-language path; never a gate.

comparison_policy.notes: Build the family picture from the learner profile first. If focus, best and known languages do not give enough context, add reference languages until the relationships are visible. Never add filler once the learner already has enough.

scene_sequence.notes: The opening hello: hear one word in the language and pick it. Opens the whole path.

experience_blueprint.notes: Stop 1 of the Meet-a-language path. A word to hear and pick comes before any explanation; the same scene data must render in app, print and video.

notes: Genealogy is a historical relationship model, not a claim that related languages are mutually intelligible or culturally interchangeable. Language realizations own the genealogy facts; the runtime chooses what to show from the learner context. See curriculum-v2/INTRO_FACTS.md.
